executive_summary.text: Current ownership interests reported to CMS: HC SNF OPERATIONS HOLDINGS LLC (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest); MOSHE GOTTLIEB (Indirect Ownership Interest); HADASSA M HIRSCH (Indirect Ownership Interest); LEAH SONNENSCHEIN (Indirect Ownership Interest); SHAINDY TAUBER (Indirect Ownership Interest).

Current operational/managerial control reported to CMS: PINCHOS Z BAK (since 02/01/2026); MOSHE GOTTLIEB (since 02/01/2026); NICKEISHA BEWRY-CLARKE (since 02/01/2026); PAUL MONACO (since 02/01/2026); PINCHOS Z BAK (since 02/01/2026).
Cost year 2025: total nursing pool (agency) fees on the report were $1,140,614, of which -$460 is counted in direct care.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 4 line(s) of the report, a net increase of $99,986 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Other Movable Equipment (page 27 line 12C2), added $126,729; Accounting And Auditing (page 15 line 1d), removed $18,000; Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7d), removed $7,126. Separately, the home itself removed $1,277,527 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.
CMS lists 37 health citations for this home between 2019-01-14 and 2026-09-02, including 0 at actual harm or immediate jeopardy level (0 immediate jeopardy).
In 2026Q2, total nurse staffing was 3.92 hours per resident day (RN 0.4, LPN 1.13, aides 2.39); the Connecticut median that quarter was 3.82.
Missing data: No related parties or management-service payees were read from the cost year 2025 report. That means none were read, not that none exist.

tables.title: Support department costs, cost year 2025
tables.description: Wages alone are not department spending: each department's total is wages + its share of fringe benefits + non-wage costs (supplies, purchased services, other).

tables.title: Cost-report figures by year
tables.description: Only years that passed the site's checks. check_status 'unvalidated' means the printed totals did not fully reconcile; treat those figures as provisional. Statewide medians use validated reports only.

tables.title: Largest changes in DSS's review, cost year 2025
tables.description: What the home reported, what it removed itself, and what DSS's review changed. 'Moved between lines' means the cost was reclassified, not removed. The data does not give reasons.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
